directives.intent: U.N. Arbitration Court has produced 0 net minerals for multiple turns, so nothing it queues can ever finish; get it to a positive surplus via terraforming or tile reassignment before asking it for colony pods.

U.N. Planning Authority carries 5 citizens but nets 0 minerals after support, so finish the Formers and terraform its worked tiles to at least 4 minerals/turn before queueing any maintenance-bearing facility or support-costing unit here.
U.N. Headquarters must reach a positive mineral surplus via Formers-driven terraforming before it queues another colony pod, since at 0 surplus nothing it builds can ever complete.

U.N. Peace Citadel takes in 2 minerals at pop 2 but nets 0 after support, so nothing it queues can finish; hold the Formers and terraform its worked tiles to at least 2 minerals/turn before queueing any support-costing unit or maintenance-bearing facility here.

U.N. Humanity Haven has 4 citizens but only +1 mineral/turn, so finish the Formers and terraform its worked tiles to at least 4 minerals/turn before queueing any support-costing unit or maintenance-bearing facility here.

U.N. Liberty Haven is stuck at pop 1 with 2 minerals and +1 nutrient per turn, so terraform with the Formers now queued until it clears 4 minerals/turn before queueing another colony pod or any maintenance-bearing facility here.

Every one of our six bases reports 0 mineral surplus while we support 8 military units, so stop adding units until terraforming lifts intake — support cost is what is holding every base's production at zero.

All six bases report 0 mineral surplus while 8 military units draw support, so nothing any base queues can ever complete; shed units down to 5 to return minerals to production and unblock the terraforming that every yields-first directive depends on.

U.N. Arbitration Court produces 0 net minerals at pop 1, so nothing it queues can ever finish; terraform with the Formers being built here until it clears 2 minerals/turn before queueing colony pods or facilities again.
U.N. Headquarters cannot finish its Formers from a 0 mineral surplus, so bank energy instead of spending it until reserves can hot-rush the 20-mineral Formers and break the zero-surplus deadlock.

U.N. Resilience Center produces only 2 minerals/turn at pop 1, so finish the Formers and terraform its tiles to at least 4 minerals/turn before queueing any unit that costs support or any maintenance-bearing facility here.
